testcase.name: Scenario: Switch the Boolean selector from icons to named options: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/solid-model/extrusion/extrusion.feature:415:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Switch the Boolean selector from icons to named options ✔> Given the MCAD Software is displaying a part in the solid modeling workspace ✔> And the viewport pointer is idle ✔ Given a fresh copy of `fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-base-circle.opd` is open in a solid extrusion with its circular profile selected ✔ When the user changes the Boolean selector style from Icons to Dropdown ✔ And the user opens the Boolean dropdown ✔ Then it offers Join, Cut, Intersect and New Solid ✔ And switching the selector style has not changed the currently selected operation
